# AI Wellness Pal

> AI Wellness Pal is a free AI wellness coach app for iPhone and Android. Each day a 30-second check-in (energy, mood, how your body feels and how much time you have) becomes Today’s Plan: two to four small, doable actions for mood, sleep, movement and nutrition. An AI companion, the Wellness Pal, helps you follow through, alongside a journal, habit tracking and nine everyday wellness tools.

Key facts:
- Platforms: iPhone (iOS 15.0 or later) and Android (8.0 or later). App Store and Google Play.
- Price: free to download and use, no ads. Optional Premium subscription (US App Store: $14.99/month or $89.99/year, 7-day free trial). Free: daily check-ins and plans, AI journal, habits and challenges, hydration/sleep/period/weight tracking, meditation and breathing, widgets, and 3 Wellness Pal chat messages per day. Premium: unlimited chat, Live Chat Pal real-time voice, AI food analysis (photo/description/barcode), AI meal plans, AI sleep/hydration/calorie insights, the full Wellness Studio and more.
- Launched: App Store on 5 October 2026; Google Play in October 2026.
- Developer: Viraj Dhanushka (independent developer). Support: aiwellnesspal@gmail.com.
- AI: Google Gemini models via Firebase AI Logic. The app asks for permission before any personal information is sent to the AI.
- Privacy: no advertising, no selling of data, no cross-app tracking; accounts and data can be deleted at any time.
- Health data: reads sleep (only) from Apple Health on iPhone or Health Connect on Android, with permission; never writes health data.
- Not a medical device and not medical advice.
- Language: English.

## Features
- [Daily check-in & plan](https://aiwelnesspal.com/features/ai-wellness-coach/): A 30-second check-in becomes Today’s Plan: two to four small actions that fit your energy and time.
- [Wellness Pal AI chat](https://aiwelnesspal.com/features/ai-wellness-chat/): Chat or talk with an AI companion that knows your check-ins, and can log, plan and remind for you.
- [AI journal & reflections](https://aiwelnesspal.com/features/ai-journal/): Guided prompts based on your real week, and supportive, specific responses from your Pal.
- [AI nutrition coach](https://aiwelnesspal.com/features/ai-nutrition-coach/): Snap, describe or scan a meal for an AI estimate of calories, macros, fiber and a food quality score.
- [AI meal planner](https://aiwelnesspal.com/features/ai-meal-planner/): A day, a week or a month of meals built around your goal, diet and calorie target, with a grocery list.
- [Calorie budget](https://aiwelnesspal.com/features/calorie-tracker/): Food and exercise in one place: your daily budget, what you’ve eaten, what you’ve burned and what’s left.
- [Water tracker](https://aiwelnesspal.com/features/water-tracker/): A daily water target that fits you, one-tap logging, a hydration score and streaks.
- [Sleep coach](https://aiwelnesspal.com/features/sleep-tracker/): A sleep score, sleep stages and the habits behind them, from Apple Health or Health Connect.
- [Meditation & breathing](https://aiwelnesspal.com/features/meditation-breathing/): Box breathing, 4-7-8, body scans and stress relief in 1 to 15 minutes, all free in Meditation Pal.
- [Period tracker](https://aiwelnesspal.com/features/period-tracker/): Log your cycle, see your next period and fertile window, and get tips for each phase.
- [Weight & BMI tracker](https://aiwelnesspal.com/features/weight-tracker/): Log weigh-ins in kg or lb and see your trend, change over time and BMI.
- [Habits & challenges](https://aiwelnesspal.com/features/habit-tracker/): Build habits on your schedule with reminders, streaks and multi-day challenges.
- [Home-screen widgets](https://aiwelnesspal.com/features/home-screen-widgets/): Today’s plan, habits and every tool on your home screen, on iPhone and Android.
